purpose: Stress-test c-factor placement for the selected x0=ct rehearsal branch and held x0=t translation branch.

rows.x0_ct_branch: d4x = dx0 d3x = c dt d3x
rows.x0_t_branch: d4x = dt d3x, but metric determinant or line-element convention must carry the c placement

rows.x0_ct_branch: c^3/G on dx0 d3x becomes c^4/G after dx0=c dt
rows.x0_t_branch: c^4/G can appear directly when t is used and line element carries c dt
partial_0 = partial_t if x0=t, with c factors carried elsewhere

rows.x0_ct_branch: N and h dimensionless; dimensionless beta^i preferred
rows.x0_t_branch: N can remain dimensionless if c is explicit in the line element; shift may be velocity-like or beta^i after rescaling

rows.x0_ct_branch: R and ADM curvature terms carry m^-2 after derivative conversion
rows.x0_t_branch: same physical dimension only if metric and derivative c factors are consistently allocated

rows.x0_ct_branch: temporal scalar terms inherit 1/c through each partial_0 to partial_t conversion
rows.x0_t_branch: time derivative is direct but metric inverse and lapse factors carry the c allocation

result: The x0=ct branch survives v5_x2 as the safer rehearsal branch. x0=t remains usable only as a held translation branch.
gate_effect: dimensional_si_consistency remains open because the curvature bundle, scalar dimensions, and source authority are not fully frozen.
